findings.quote: The HCl extract was neutralized with 2M NaOH
findings.message: The HCl extraction retains the aqueous acid extract for subsequent neutralization. Its phase identity is supported even though its top/bottom position is unspecified.

findings.quote: extracted with EtOAc and the EtOAc phase was dried (K2CO3)
findings.message: The subsequent extraction explicitly retains the EtOAc organic phase for drying and evaporation; keep_phase should not be unknown.

patch.value: “The HCl extract was neutralized with 2M NaOH” identifies the retained aqueous acid extract, and “the EtOAc phase was dried (K2CO3)” identifies the retained organic phase after the subsequent extraction. Neither phase's top/bottom position is specified.
